name: Tenbin Gold
oneLiner: tGLD is Tenbin's private-beta synthetic gold token tracking one troy ounce via USDC reserves hedged with CME gold futures, redeemable in USD stablecoin.
collateral: Synthetic gold exposure, not vaulted bullion: each token represents the USD value of one troy ounce of gold at the LBMA PM spot price. Backed by USDC held on-chain and at prime broker Hidden Road, with gold price exposure obtained via CME gold futures. Issued as a Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC debt-note (a UCC Article 12 controllable electronic record)
pegMechanism: KYC-gated mint and redemption through a Controller that processes off-chain signed orders; a Tenbin backend signer holds the on-chain minter role. Redemption pays the gold-denominated value in a USD stablecoin, not physical metal. On-chain pricing uses a Chainlink tGLD/USD blended price feed

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Tenbin's mainnet deployment assigns a restricter_role (held by the admin multisig 0xE6Eb534f33A635e8d867414Af32F766D221F30d1) that flags accounts in the AssetToken restricted-accounts registry and blocks their transfers — a centralized freeze surface.

mintAuthority.summary: tGLD mints through a Tenbin-operated backend signer that holds the on-chain minter role and processes KYC-gated off-chain signed orders via the Controller; the owner multisig can grant or revoke that minter role and the dev multisig sets the supply cap and manages authorized signers.

controls.label: tGLD minter (Tenbin backend signer)

routeChecks.signingModel: Tenbin deployments identify this backend signer as minter_role; mints use KYC-gated off-chain signed orders processed through the Controller.
routeChecks.caps: Supply cap is controlled by the separate dev multisig cap_adjuster_role; signer-side hard limits were not resolved.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The custody model for the backend signing keys and any HSM/rate-limit enforcement remain unresolved.

controls.evidence: Holds minter_role on the tGLD deployment per Tenbin's deployments.json; mints execute from off-chain KYC-gated signed orders processed through the Controller (0x5e631388b24ec493619DAEEAef6fc34B33d97Dcd).

controls.label: Owner multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Owner multisig holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can grant or revoke minter_role and other privileged roles.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The multisig implementation, threshold, signer set, modules, and guard were not independently verified.

controls.evidence: Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the tGLD deployment per deployments.json; can grant or revoke minter_role and other privileged roles. Multisig threshold and signer set not independently verified.

controls.label: Dev multisig (cap adjuster + signer manager)
controls.evidence: Holds cap_adjuster_role (can raise the supply cap) and signer_manager_role (controls which off-chain signers may authorize mints) per deployments.json. Multisig threshold and signer set not independently verified.

review.evidence: Tenbin's public deployments.json (verified contracts repo) enumerates minter_role (backend-signer EOA 0xCa2D7CfAa96290171c98e112c73fC87c2AE2fe9B plus the protocol multicall), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (owner multisig), and cap_adjuster_role / signer_manager_role (dev multisig). Minting is gated by the Controller's off-chain signed-order flow. The multisigs' threshold and signer composition were not independently verified on-chain, so confidence is manual-review.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether the admin, owner, and dev multisigs are Gnosis Safes and their exact threshold and signer composition.
Whether the off-chain minter signing keys are HSM-bound and subject to on-chain rate limits or mint caps.

reserves.name: USDC collateral (on-chain manager + Hidden Road prime-brokerage custody; CME gold-futures margin)

notices.title: Synthetic gold debt-note, no published proof-of-reserves
notices.message: tGLD is not vaulted physical gold. Each token is a Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) debt-note backed by USDC reserves with gold exposure hedged via CME futures, redeemable only in a USD stablecoin under KYC. No independent proof-of-reserves attestation is published, and public on-chain liquidity is currently minimal (private beta).

launchPhaseDetail: Live on Ethereum mainnet since 2026-02-10 in private beta (~$232K market cap, ~54 tGLD, ~36 holders). tGLD is a synthetic gold debt-note from Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC: USDC-collateralized with gold exposure hedged via CME futures, KYC-gated mint/redeem, redeemable in USD stablecoin (no physical metal). Its only public market is a dormant Uniswap V4 tGLD/USDC pool, so CoinGecko's price updates are stale (multi-day) and currently fail Pharos's gold price-freshness gate — live tracking begins once a usable public price feed exists. A staked variant stGLD (ERC-4626) and testnet sibling FX tokens (tBRL, tMXN) exist; in May 2026 Tenbin deprecated LayerZero following internal security audits and migrated tGLD (and the FX siblings) exclusively to Chainlink CCIP.
